{{Quote|We thought you were dead! C'mere, you black-hearted scampweasel!|Ptor, to Trever Flume|<ref name="The Last of the Jedi: Secret Weapon" />}}
A '''scampweasel''' was a type of [[Weasel/Legends|weasel]].<ref name="The Last of the Jedi: Secret Weapon" /> Around [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]],<ref name="Dates">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[The Last of the Jedi: Secret Weapon]]'' to around [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]].</ref> the [[The Eleven|resistance]] fighter [[Trever Flume]] returned to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bellassa/Legends|Bellassa]] and reunited with the [[Gender/Legends|man]] [[Ptor]], who had watched out for him while he lived on the street. Ptor, who had believed Flume to be [[Death/Legends|dead]], hugged him and called him a "[[Color/Legends|black]]-hearted scampweasel."<ref name="The Last of the Jedi: Secret Weapon" />

==Behind the scenes==
A scampweasel was mentioned in ''[[The Last of the Jedi: Secret Weapon]]'', a [[2007]] junior novel written by [[Jude Watson]] as the seventh installment in the ''[[Star Wars: The Last of the Jedi]]'' series.<ref name="The Last of the Jedi: Secret Weapon" />
